text: Design can be art. Design can be aesthetics. Design is so simple, that’s why it is so complicated.
author: Paul Rand

text: There are three responses to a piece of design. Yes, no and wow! Wow is the one to aim for.
author: Milton Glaser

text: Digital design is like painting, except the paint never dries.
author: Neville Brody

text: Practice safe design. Use a concept.
author: Patrula Vrontikis

text: Each color lives by its mysterious life.
author: Wassily Kandinsky

text: I am always doing that which I cannot do, in order that I may learn how to do it.
author: Pablo Picasso
